import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import unittest

root = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'src'))
modules = [
    'tests.test_federation', 'tests.test_rendered_federation',
    'tests.test_local_federation', 'tests.test_public_bundle_context',
    'tests.test_query_store', 'tests.test_query_store_evolution',
    'tests.test_consultation', 'tests.test_consultation_periods',
    'tests.test_packet_freshness', 'tests.test_conversation_archives',
    'tests.test_archive_selection', 'tests.test_archive_v2',
    'tests.test_archive_diagrams', 'tests.test_archive_delivery',
    'tests.test_archive_continuation', 'tests.test_archive_attribution',
    'tests.test_extraction', 'tests.test_curation',
    'tests.test_curation_transformations', 'tests.test_private_garden_workflow',
    'tests.test_v1_contracts',
]
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(modules)
started = time.monotonic()
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=1).run(suite)
origins = {
    name: str(Path(module.__file__).resolve().relative_to(root))
    for name, module in sorted(sys.modules.items())
    if name.startswith('mindgarden') and getattr(module, '__file__', None)
}
assert all(value.startswith('src/mindgarden/') for value in origins.values())
receipt = {
    'python': platform.python_version(),
    'base_revision': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
    'command': 'PYTHONPATH="$PWD/src" ' + sys.executable + ' -m unittest ' + ' '.join(modules) + ' --verbose',
    'runner': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'modules': modules,
    'tests': result.testsRun,
    'seconds': round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
    'failures': len(result.failures),
    'errors': len(result.errors),
    'skips': len(result.skipped),
    'engine_origins': origins,
    'test_sha256': {name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ('tests/test_consultation_periods.py', 'tests/test_archive_attribution.py')},
}
(root / '.cache' / ('acceptance-tests-' + sys.argv[1] + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and not result.skipped else 1)

import importlib.metadata
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
import unittest
mode, root, report_path = sys.argv[1], Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve(), Path(sys.argv[3])
if mode != 'wheel':
 sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'src'))
import mindgarden
expected = Path(sys.prefix).resolve() if mode=='wheel' else root/'src'
assert Path(mindgarden.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(expected)
if mode=='wheel':
 distributions=sorted(item.metadata['Name'] for item in importlib.metadata.distributions())
 assert distributions==['mindgarden'],distributions
else:
 distributions='site-disabled'
sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
modules=['tests.test_consultation_periods','tests.test_archive_attribution','tests.test_query_store_evolution','tests.test_standalone_integration','tests.test_private_garden_workflow']
started=time.monotonic()
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=sys.stdout,verbosity=1).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(modules))
if not result.wasSuccessful() or result.skipped:
 raise SystemExit(1)
origins=[Path(module.__file__).resolve() for name,module in sys.modules.items() if name.startswith('mindgarden') and getattr(module,'__file__',None)]
assert origins and all(path.is_relative_to(expected) for path in origins),origins
report={'mode':mode,'tests':result.testsRun,'skipped':len(result.skipped),'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),'modules':modules,'verified_module_origins':len(origins),'distributions':distributions,'status':'passed'}
report_path.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report),flush=True)
